comment: Compiles the fixture the way an external consumer would: it imports the
resolved through node_modules — NOT via a paths mapping. `check.mjs` packs
the package with `npm pack` and extracts the tarball into
test/consumer/node_modules/zod-nostr first, so resolution goes through the
real package.json#exports and the tarball's `files` — catching a dropped
'./mini' export, a missing declaration, or a wrong entry point, on top of the
emitted-.d.ts type contract. Run it with `npm run test:consumer`.
